description: This file defines the interface and data structures for Redis's Rio (Redis I/O) abstraction layer, including function prototypes, macros, and the 'rio' struct for handling various I/O targets such as files, buffers, connections, and file descriptors.

methods.name: rioWrite
methods.description: Writes data to the rio stream, updating checksum and handling errors.

methods.name: rioRead
methods.description: Reads data from the rio stream, updating checksum and handling errors.

methods.name: rioTell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the rio stream.

methods.name: rioFlush
methods.description: Flushes the rio stream.

methods.name: rioGetReadError
methods.description: Checks if a read error has occurred in the rio stream.

methods.name: rioGetWriteError
methods.description: Checks if a write error has occurred in the rio stream.

methods.name: rioClearErrors
methods.description: Clears error flags in the rio stream.

methods.name: rioInitWithFile
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with a FILE pointer.

methods.name: rioInitWithBuffer
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with an in-memory buffer.

methods.name: rioInitWithConn
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with a network connection.

methods.name: rioInitWithFd
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with a file descriptor.

methods.name: rioFreeFd
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a file descriptor target.

methods.name: rioFreeConn
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a connection target.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkCount
methods.description: Writes a bulk count to the rio stream.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkString
methods.description: Writes a bulk string to the rio stream.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkLongLong
methods.description: Writes a long long value as bulk data.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkDouble
methods.description: Writes a double value as bulk data.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkObject
methods.description: Writes a redisObject as bulk data.

methods.name: rioGenericUpdateChecksum
methods.description: Updates the checksum with new data.

methods.name: rioSetAutoSync
methods.description: Sets auto-sync threshold for buffered data.

methods.name: rioCheckType
methods.description: Checks the type of the rio target.
